Hi Tyler —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses inline:

1) Discounting: we typically tier discounts based on annual committed $s and effective utilization. For a 3-year prepay with a ramp like you described, we can propose:
   - Year 1: 20% off list (applies to committed units)
   - Year 2: 25% (if utilization >= 60%)
   - Year 3: 30% (if utilization >= 70%)

   If actual usage in a given year exceeds committed units, overage pricing applies at the discounted rate — so you don't lose the benefit. We'll include a ramp schedule tab in the term sheet.

2) Early termination / co-terming: we can support pro-rated refunds on unused prepay on termination, but there are two common approaches:
   A) Time-based pro rata (simple): refund = remaining term % * prepay value, less a 10% early termination processing fee.
   B) Usage-protected (preferred by larger customers): guaranteed minimum usage thresholds per year; if thresholds not met, partial refund subject to a retention amount to cover reserved capacity costs.

Let's set a short call to pick which approach fits your procurement policy. Attached is a draft term sheet and a sample ramp schedule for reference.

Proposed times: Wed 10–11am PT or Thu 2–3pm PT. Which works?

Thanks —
Karthik

- Co-terming fee: we proposed a one-time administrative alignment fee equal to 2% of the outstanding prepay value for entities co-terming mid-contract (covers reallocation and contractual amendment processing). - Early termination, recommended model: usage-protected refund with clear audit checks. Example math (from workbook):

Subject: Draft redlines: Termination & Co-terming clauses (for review)

Samantha / Tyler —

Attached are the proposed redlines to the draft term sheet (tracked changes) focused on:
- §6 Early Termination: deterministic refund formula tied to (a) unused prepaid $; (b) utilization shortfall; (c) a fixed 8% processing fee (we reduced from 10% after today's discussion).
- §9 Co-terming: one-time administrative alignment fee = 2% of outstanding prepay OR a flat $25k floor (whichever is greater); co-terming does not change committed capacity unless both parties sign an amendment.
- Auditability: monthly usage export and a quarterly reconciliation window; any disputes escalate to a third-party arbiter if unresolved after 60 days.

Please review the tracked changes and let us know any redlines you need. If legal prefers, we can convert the usage-protected refund model to a pure time-pro rata (simpler) but that would reduce the refundable amount in low-utilization scenarios.

Next steps: once you confirm redlines, we'll produce the final signature-ready term sheet and pull procurement PO wording for your finance team.
